question: To which state of India does swimmer Srihari Nataraj belong?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Karnataka**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Srihari Nataraj** is a renowned Indian swimmer who hails from **Karnataka**, a state located in southern India.
 
• He has represented India in multiple international swimming competitions, including the **Olympics** and **Asian Games**.
 
• Srihari is known for his exceptional performance in **backstroke events**.
 
• The state of **Karnataka** has been instrumental in nurturing sports talent with its robust infrastructure and support systems, especially in cities like **Bengaluru**, which have top-notch training facilities.
 
• Srihari trained extensively at the **Basavanagudi Aquatic Centre** in Bengaluru, one of the premier swimming training institutes in India.
 
• He has set multiple **national records** in swimming and has emerged as one of India’s leading swimmers, inspiring many young athletes in Karnataka and across India.
 
• His achievements underline Karnataka’s contribution to Indian sports and its emphasis on promoting swimming as a competitive sport.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ** Gujarat**__

 __
 
• **Gujarat** is primarily known for producing athletes in sports like cricket and athletics, rather than swimming.
 
• The state has a coastline, but it lacks the established swimming infrastructure found in Karnataka.
 
• Gujarat is famous for other contributions in sports, such as the **National Games 2022**, which were held there showcasing various sports disciplines.
 
 
 
• **Kerala**__
 __
 
• **Kerala** is known for its strong presence in aquatic sports due to its abundant water bodies like rivers and backwaters.
 
• The state has produced several swimmers and water sports athletes, but **Srihari Nataraj** is not associated with Kerala.
 
• Kerala is also famous for its traditional boat races like the **Nehru Trophy Boat Race**.
 
 
 
• **Maharashtra**__
 
 
• **Maharashtra** has a significant contribution to sports in India, including swimming.
 
• The state has produced notable athletes in various sports, such as **cricket, athletics, and badminton**.
 
• While Maharashtra has good swimming infrastructure, **Srihari Nataraj** belongs to Karnataka.
